title: How a Godly Man Builds Brothers Who'd Notice If He Went Quiet
caption:
Most guys have plenty of friends and zero brothers. There's a difference between guys who like your posts and guys who'd notice if you went quiet for a week.

Brotherhood isn't a group chat. It's a real number, a real answer on the second ask, and showing up when it costs you something. It's confessing before he has to.

You don't need ten guys like this. You need two or three. Start with one this week.
